snippet.title: Home Sweet Gnome - Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
Play as Saga, a small gnome with big dreams, as she opens a Bed and Breakfast for creatures from Nordic folklore! Welcome guests, decorate rooms, explore the forest and make strange friends in Home Sweet Gnome - a cozy, hand-painted adventure🌲🍄☕️

Available to wishlist on Steam!💌

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3819560/Home_Sweet_Gnome/
Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/PHxeTwygZU

Music: Marcus Vallgren
Sound Design: Jacob Akpinar Olsson - dofhouse AB
